title: Scenario
description: Ordered endpoint calls, e.g. create → verify → delete. Values saved from responses feed later steps.

kind.description: read: always run, read endpoints only. write: opt-in, cleans up after itself. settings: opt-in, changes are not undone. setup: run when an API needs it (catalog.json apis.<name>.setup).

description.description: What it changes; shown before it runs.

inputs.description: Values asked for before running (e.g. a throwaway email).

save.description: variable → response path, e.g. "cameraGroups[0].cameraGroupId". A trailing ? makes it optional.

contains.description: path → value that must be among the values at path.

equals.description: path → value the first match must equal.

cleanup.description: Run at the end of the scenario (last created, first removed) if this step's call succeeded. Nested cleanup steps run after it.

otherwise.description: For cleanup steps: a fallback if the step fails.
